subject: Re: STraTA status: repro strong, self-training stability caveat
body:
Umar, Alina,

Adoption review outcome, closing the window:

1. The STraTA recipe ships as the recommended low-label bootstrapping path, with the dev-set requirement baked in as a hard precondition - the recipe refuses to run self-training rounds without one. Umar's misconfiguration demo (the 4-point round-3 drift) goes in the doc as the cautionary example; nothing teaches like a concrete failure.

2. The data-labeling use case ships as "supported, second priority" - two internal teams already asked for it, but I don't want it competing with the classifier story for support bandwidth this quarter.

3. Nikhil's distillation configs made the cut for v1: the compressed students hold 96-98% of teacher accuracy at roughly a quarter of the serving cost, which is the number that makes the whole recipe commercially real.

Adoption target: three internal teams by end of Q2. Nice work everyone.

Anders
